correctness.rationale: Gaussian sign correlation gives the arcsine kernel. Splitting at the sampled time and integrating by parts gives π(s−1+√(1−s))/2 for the left integral and π(√s−s)/2 for the right, hence the sign cross moment a(s). Integrating the same covariance over both times gives Var(A)=1/12. Sign reversal sends A−1/2 to its negative (the zero set has zero Lebesgue measure almost surely by Fubini), so the conditional expectation on the four positive-probability atoms is odd, hence in the span of the two signs without a decoder restriction. The covariance matrix has determinant 1−c²>0 and its inverse gives the stated risk by orthogonal projection. For reflected sites, log V=2 log a−log(1+c); a>0 is strictly concave, and for g=arcsin(s/(1−s)), g''/(g')²=(2−r)/√(1−r²)>1>2/π, giving strict convexity of log(1+c). Near zero a behaves as √s/2, whereas at 1/2 the c slope diverges and the a slope vanishes. The logarithmic derivative thus crosses zero exactly once and gives the stated equation; this is not an assertion about asymmetric designs. At trisection c=1/3, same-sign atoms each have mass 1/3 and the two opposite-sign atoms combine into the third estimate of mass 1/3; the radical is an absolute explained variance (not a dimensionless fraction). Independent quadrature of the trivariate sign-orthant conditional means at trisection and an asymmetric pair, and slope bisection, replay with `cd /workspace && python -B -c 'import independent_checks as c; c.occupation()'`. They give s*=0.33678496676200454… and explained variance 0.05817302901099651…. The frozen 1359-assertion output was read, not rerun. The frozen self-review wording about the trisection improvement reverses the direction; the actual RESULT and numerical evidence correctly put the symmetric optimum slightly above trisection.

value.rationale: The exact all-pair error and unrestricted decoder give a usable benchmark for two bits observing a nonlinear continuous-time quantity. The unique reflected solution and exact three-level trisection calibration illustrate the measurement geometry. The scientific value is the risk law and design classification, not the numerically tiny improvement over trisection; more than 69.8% explained variance contrasts with about 51.47% for a single midpoint sign. No global asymmetric optimum is asserted.
